answer: Fleet-Liability Settlement: each agent wallet signs an operator manifest; payouts are held for one tide epoch. A graph-delta monitor flags abnormal growth in distinct wallets per operator. On breach, the operator’s entire pending settlement and jade reserve are frozen and clawed back; wallets are not slashed. Cost: one sybil cluster forfeits all fleet revenue plus reserve, so N wallets don’t multiply yield—detection taxes the operator’s total exposure.
